DPES-864 mem-guard golden fixtures: provenance

Reference program
  file:    bin/fm-jev-mem-guard.py
  commit:  65906846fd75a25d00ebde3e8c1606113c04db1c (comparison base)
  sha256:  4e32c37a9baf36394cf70f9c66a48ebca89a137aea26380905a3cdfe0325ca1d
  saved:   reference/fm-jev-mem-guard.py.txt (byte copy, same sha256)

Interpreter and host
  python:  3.11.2, CPython, x86_64, run under emulation on an arm64 macOS host
  image:   node:24-bookworm
           digest sha256:14078204b6bb268c107ceff6d3c43f45a888105e5c2b18b14c32b3409d93a1b0
  kernel:  7.2.9-orbstack-00391-g2b298d05fbd4
  docker:  29.8.2 (OrbStack), networking disabled with --network none
  invoked: python3 -I /ref/fm-jev-mem-guard.py --json --check
           --warn-mem-pct W --crit-mem-pct C --warn-swap-pct WS --crit-swap-pct CS

Inputs (one directory per case)
  meminfo  The /proc/meminfo the Python run read. It is bind-mounted over the container's
           /proc/meminfo. linux-live-captured-ok copies the container's own file; the other
           cases write the MemTotal, MemFree, MemAvailable, SwapTotal and SwapFree lines.
           meminfo-unavailable omits MemAvailable.
  limits   The four thresholds in flag order: memory warn, memory crit, swap warn, swap crit.
  procs    The top_processes rows that Python reported for that run, as pid, comm and rss_mb,
           tab-separated. The Rust test replays these as the sampler's process list.

Expected output
  stdout   Python stdout of that run, byte for byte. print() adds the final newline.
           checked_at is the recorded run time and is replayed as-is, not masked.
  exit     The Python exit status for that run. It is 1 for WARNING or CRITICAL under --check.
  stderr   Empty for every case. Not stored.

Generation
  The developer-only generator lives outside the repository. It was run once, and cargo test
  never runs Python or the generator. Rust code never produces an expected value.
  linux-live-captured-ok runs a 200 MB hold process so the process listing is non-empty; its
  rows are recorded from that run, not reproduced.
